editorial:
Imagine waking up from a deep sleep and accidentally stumbling into a rocket ship. That is exactly what happens to Bugs Bunny in this wild ride. You get to see the world's most famous rabbit deal with the shock of being blasted into deep space. The vibe is pure chaos and laughter as Bugs tries to figure out where he is while being chased by grumpy aliens. It is a classic cartoon setup that feels fresh because it puts a familiar character in a totally strange environment. You will love how Bugs stays cool and collected even when things get crazy around him.

The animation is smooth and the timing of the jokes is perfect. You will notice how the fast pace keeps you interested from start to finish. While it is a short film, it packs a lot of punch with its funny action scenes. If you want to see this in the best quality possible, you should definitely add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for those crisp colors. You could also look for it when renting on Apple TV for a quick laugh. It is a great pick for families or anyone who needs a break from serious movies.
endingExplained: After a lot of running and dodging, Bugs manages to outsmart the martians using his usual tricks. He finds a way to launch himself back toward Earth, leaving the aliens frustrated and confused in his wake. The story wraps up with Bugs safely landing back home, proving that no matter how far he travels into space, he is always the smartest guy in the room. He gets back to his quiet life just like nothing happened.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Looney Tunes and silly sci-fi adventures.
